dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: You don't make it out to Gandharva Ville often, and there wasn't time for visiting earlier, so why don't you stay a few more days?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Not really... We usually just go camping, do a little fishing, have a barbecue, things like that.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #Oh, and we invite {NICKNAME} along too, if {M#he's}{F#she's} in town.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Nice! I love camping! And a barbecue is a must!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Don't get too excited. You might not know this, but Tighnari doesn't use seasoning when he grills.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Don't listen to him, Sethos. I prefer a clean taste, but you can put on as much as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: *sigh* You could've at least played along...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hehe. Man, it's a shame Hat Guy hasn't been around lately, or I'd invite him to join — he's the perfect buffer for your nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I wouldn't mind him tagging along, either. It's just a shame he doesn't play cards.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Seriously, though, where did he go? Has anyone seen him around at all?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I heard he's taking care of something in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Oh, well I hope it all works out.
